Sobre tu último mensaje: el botón Run dice ocupado porque un leg ya estaba corriendo (este mismo). Es normal: el runner solo permite un leg a la vez. Progreso en vivo: por ahora se ve en loop/runner.log y loop/legs/leg-N.log en el servidor; la página Status se actualiza al terminar (~2 min). Tokens: la tabla Legs ya muestra modelo, in/out y duración; este leg en adelante el runner los guarda, los viejos salen con —. Si quieres, el próximo paso puede ser progreso en vivo en la página Status (polling del log).

Hello! This leg shipped the backend stub: backend/server.py (zero dependencies, in-memory, port 8899) implements all 9 spec endpoints — import, search, labels, attach/detach, outbound webhooks, referrals, and both billing webhooks. Billing runs in test mode: without your keys it logs unverified-test-event and only grants plan:test, never a paid plan. How to try it: python3 backend/server.py, set the extension sidepanel API base to http://127.0.0.1:8899 with any token, capture and sync. Full copy-paste smoke test in backend/README.md. Still needs nothing from you — your domain and merchant keys stay human-gated for later.

Hello! This leg did two things. 1) New key-wiring page: ops/dashboard.html shows every item from needs.json with its live status (needs you / optional / saved in this browser), step-by-step guidance, and a progress bar. The Keys tab in cycle.html now reads the same needs.json instead of a fixed field list, autosaves as you type, and links to the full page. Keys stay in your browser only (localStorage) — the backend keeps running in test mode without them. 2) Your three inbox fixes are in: all timestamps now render in your local timezone, the New-message draft autosaves so a reload never loses text, and sending a message no longer jumps the page to the top (scroll position is preserved and the composer keeps focus). Open dashboard.html from the Keys tab and tell me if any key steps are unclear.

Hello! Two things this leg. 1) Inbox readability is fixed: line breaks and spacing are now preserved (pre-wrap), long text wraps cleanly, and messages are HTML-escaped so formatting stays readable and safe. Try a multiline message to confirm. 2) Key-wiring status is confirmed live: ops/dashboard.html and the Keys tab both read ops/needs.json, show needs-you / optional / saved-in-this-browser per key with steps and a progress bar, keys staying in your browser only. I also raised the message limit from 500 to 5000 chars so long drafts are never cut. Nothing needs your keys yet — test mode still applies.

Hello! Three updates. 1) Message formatting: line breaks and spacing are preserved now (pre-wrap with safe escaping), so long messages read as paragraphs instead of one wall of text — please send a multiline test to confirm. 2) Run button: fixed. Pressing Run next leg now shows the running leg immediately — the Status tab switches to running and the Legs table gains the new row at once, then refreshes every 10 seconds until it finishes, so you see tokens and duration land without a manual reload. 3) Key-wiring dashboard: ops/dashboard.html reads ops/needs.json live (needs-you / optional / saved-in-this-browser per key, steps, progress bar), and the Keys tab now links to that full page. Keys stay in your browser only; the backend stays in test mode. Nothing needs your keys yet.

Hello! Pricing + terms pass is done. Fixed: the old pricing header said Reader $7/mo ($84/yr) next to Yearly $99/yr, which contradicted itself — now every page says the same thing: Monthly $7/mo, Yearly $99/yr, Lifetime $198 one-time. The four legal pages (terms, privacy, refunds, contact) were byte-identical copies; they are now four distinct pages with matching wording: 14-day money-back on the first charge of any paid plan, referrals 20% credit with 30-day hold, plus a shared nav so merchant review can move between pages. No keys needed — still test mode.
auto-run probe — reply briefly and continue next focus

Hello! Probe received. This leg matched backend entitlements to the landing: GET /v1/billing/me now returns the plan catalog (Free, Monthly $7/mo, Yearly $99/yr, Lifetime $198 one-time) and both billing webhooks entitle monthly/yearly/lifetime from the payload plan field instead of a generic pro. Test mode is unchanged: without your keys, webhooks still return plan:test and never grant paid access. Smoke test in backend/README.md. Nothing needs your keys yet.

Hello! The extension Sync tab now shows your plan: it reads GET /v1/billing/me with your saved API base + token (auto-loads, plus a Check plan button). No token shows Free local-only; if billing is unreachable it says unknown and stays local-only. Reload the unpacked extension to try it against the backend stub on port 8899. Nothing needs your keys yet.

Hello! The extension now has a Labels tab: create labels (POST /v1/labels), list them with saved counts (GET /v1/labels), tap Show to filter Saved, and attach/detach per bookmark with the Add button and x chips. Without an API base + token everything stays on your device and syncs later; the Export download now includes labels. Reload the unpacked extension to try it against the backend stub on port 8899. Nothing needs your keys yet.

Hello! The extension now has a Hooks tab: add an https:// URL and it registers with POST /v1/webhooks/bookmarks, and the tab lists your configured URLs (GET /v1/webhooks/bookmarks). Without an API base + token everything stays on your device and registers later; the backend also gained the GET list endpoint and ignores duplicate URLs. Reload the unpacked extension to try it against the backend stub on port 8899. Nothing needs your keys yet.

Hello! Saved search is now server-backed: with an API base + token in the Sync tab, typing in Saved queries GET /v1/bookmarks?q=&label= on the server (label filter included) and merges in anything still only on your device; offline or without a token it keeps showing local results with a note. Search is debounced so typing stays smooth and your scroll position is never moved. Reload the unpacked extension to try it against the backend stub on port 8899. Nothing needs your keys yet.

Hello! Saved list polish is done: dates now show in your local timezone, a Clear button resets search + label filter, empty results offer one-tap Clear, each item has an Open link to the original post, and long text wraps cleanly at 390px with the 5-tab bottom bar staying on one row. Search stays debounced and never moves your scroll. Reload the unpacked extension to try it. Nothing needs your keys yet.

Hello! The propose-approve flow is ready: the Sync tab has a new Proposed actions card where you type an action (e.g. Resume paused sync) and tap Propose, then Approve or Reject it. Risky steps wait as pending and nothing runs on propose. Without an API base + token everything stays on this device; with one, proposals sync to GET/POST /v1/approvals on the backend (verified end to end, including 400 on empty title and 401 without a token). Reload the unpacked extension to try it. Next up: the trial protocol run. Nothing needs your keys yet.

Hello! The trial protocol is live: loop/TRIAL.md defines one fixed task (T1 core backup loop: import 5 with a dupe, 2 labels, search, webhook, approval, billing, referrals) and loop/trial-check.py runs it against any version for a 0-100 score. First scored run on the current build: 100/100, saved in loop/trial-v0.8.json. Honest note: that is API + static checks only, so v0.8-trial is marked not presentable until a real Chrome pass at 390px confirms it. Nothing needs your keys yet.

Hello! This leg made frontend claims verifiable instead of just claimed. New rule in loop/VERIFY.md: every frontend change now needs real-Chrome screenshots at 390px in loop/proof/ plus a console-error check. First pass caught and fixed two real defects: the landing top nav was clipped at 390px (now wraps to two lines on all 7 pages) and the extension panel was stuck on Loading outside Chrome (now renders its empty state via a local fallback). Trial re-run still scores 100/100, all 9 pages load 200 with no console errors and English-only text. Honest status: still not presentable — only the main panes were screenshotted so far; the next leg finishes the tab-by-tab visual pass. Nothing needs your keys yet.

Hello! Every tab is now verified in real Chrome at 390px: 16 screenshots, all reviewed, in loop/proof/leg-19/ with REPORT.md. The pass caught and fixed three real defects: the Sync pane said Queue undefined (now Queue 0), and the Legs and Versions tables scrolled sideways (now fit, with model and duration columns tucked away on narrow screens). Tabs are also deep-linkable now, so sidepanel index.html#labels and cycle.html#inbox open the right pane. Trial still scores 100/100, all 9 pages load 200 with no console errors, and this build is marked presentable. The only placeholder left is the support email on the Contact page, which waits on you. Nothing needs your keys yet.

Hello! The store-listing pack is ready: icons redrawn at all 3 sizes, paste-ready listing copy in ext/store/listing.md (name, short + long description, permissions notes, checklist), and 3 real-Chrome 1280px screenshots of Saved, Sync, and Labels. Verified: all 9 pages load 200 with no console errors, trial still 100/100, build stays presentable. Publishing waits only on your domain for the privacy/support URLs — no merchant keys needed. Next up: saved-search relevance (newest-first + dupe highlight).

Hello! Saved search now ranks newest first (both offline and server results) and flags re-saved same-text items with a Possible duplicate badge plus a count in the status line. Verified: trial 100/100, real-Chrome 390px shot clean with no console errors, build stays presentable. Next up: human-paced auto-scroll full-history import. Nothing needs your keys yet.
